title: VAST-VPAID-Debugger Output
description: Structured diagnostic result from the VAST-VPAID-Debugger skill.

tag_type.description: Detected payload type. VAST_Inline = contains <InLine> element. VAST_Wrapper = contains <Wrapper> and <VASTAdTagURI> but no <InLine>. VPAID = non-XML JS with VPAID API surface. Unknown = unrecognised payload.

is_valid.description: True only when critical_errors is empty AND tag_type is not Unknown. False in all other cases.

critical_errors.description: Structural violations that would cause the ad not to serve. Each entry must name the specific missing or invalid XML node or attribute.

latency_warnings.description: Non-fatal issues that increase latency risk or reduce fill rate. Each entry must reference the specific node or chain depth.
